title: BigFungiData pipeline parameters
description: Parameter schema for the BigFungiData Nextflow pipelines (funannotate.nf prediction/annotation and BFD.nf functional annotation). Only command-line-facing and commonly tuned parameters are validated; deep infrastructure paths are typed as strings. Unlisted parameters are accepted (warn-only) so the shared config can carry profile-specific settings.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Sample sheet and run-scope options shared by all profiles.

samples.description: Path to the samples.csv sample sheet. Validated against assets/schema_input.json.

n_test.description: If >0, restrict the run to the first n_test samples (testing/stub).

singularity_cache.description: Shared container image cache dir. Resolved in nextflow.config from the environment (NXF_APPTAINER_CACHEDIR / NXF_SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR / APPTAINER_CACHEDIR / SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR, first match wins) — no hardcoded default. Drives every *_sif param and the apptainer/singularity cacheDir. BFD and funannotate fail loudly at workflow start if unset. profile_interproscan6.config overrides this with its own separate containers dir.

run_scope_filters.title: Run scope and filters
run_scope_filters.description: Restrict which samples are processed and control the merge stage.

taxon.description: Restrict to one taxonomic group as RANK:VALUE (e.g. PHYLUM:Ascomycota). Empty = no filter.

asmid.description: Restrict to a single assembly by exact ASMID. Empty = no filter.

merge_all.description: true = MERGE collects all files in results/function/<tool>/; false = only this run's outputs.

skip_merge.description: Skip all MERGE_* steps (e.g. when running only new species).

run_build_duckdb.description: Rebuild db/BFD.duckdb from tables/*.parquet after MERGE_* steps complete.

db.description: Output dir for the rebuilt BFD.duckdb.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Options that apply to every profile.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the trace/report/timeline filenames so runs do not clobber each other. Defaults to the launch timestamp in yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm_ss format.

pipeline.description: Selects which pipeline main.nf includes/runs (case-insensitive; see main.nf).

funannotate_options.title: funannotate.nf options
funannotate_options.description: Genome cleaning, RNA-seq fetch, training, prediction and annotation controls.

taxondb.description: Local persistent NCBI taxdump cache dir; auto-provisioned by SETUP_TAXONDB (md5-verified download), so this rarely needs to be set. Defaults to lib/taxdump/ under launchDir.

seqcenter.description: Sequencing center label for GenBank submission.

eggnog_data_dir.description: EGGNOG_DATA_DIR (eggnog-mapper DB, e.g. /srv/projects/db/eggNOG/LATEST). Required for FUNANNOTATE_ANNOTATE's containerized funannotate annotate -- without it, EggNOG-mapper's DB-not-found stderr output confuses funannotate's version check and crashes annotate.

min_contig_len.description: Minimum contig length to retain when cleaning.

fastq_hdr_script.description: FASTQ header fix script for Trinity.

max_cpus.description: Upper CPU bound for funannotate sub-tools.

suppress.description: Filename of ASMID suppress list (one ASMID per line).

max_rnaseq_runs.description: Max paired-end SRA runs to fetch per species.

max_rnaseq_spot.description: Max spots per SRA run (0 = no cap).

max_rnaseq_reads.description: Max reads to keep after normalization.

max_rnaseq_se_runs.description: Max single-end SRA runs per species.

clean_batch_size.description: Genomes per GENOME_CLEAN_BATCH job (0 = one job per genome).

stop_after_genome_prep.description: Halt after GENOME_CLEAN(_BATCH)+MASKREPEAT_TANTAN_RUN, before RNASEQ_PREPARE/SRA work is queued.

skip_sra_query.description: Reuse existing sra_query CSVs; skip SRA_QUERY_BATCH.

antismash_databases.description: antiSMASH database directory. Defaults to reusing this cluster's antismash/8.0.4 module's own populated database dir; override for a portable off-cluster run (see profile_funannotate.config comment).

funannotate_sif.description: funannotate-live singularity image (rust-optimized PASA/EVM/Trinity). Used by FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN/UPDATE via singularity exec; GeneMark stays host-side (license), see GENEMARK_RUN_DESIGN.md.

min_assembly_len.description: Cleaned assemblies below this total length (bp) are logged to TO_ADD_TO_SUPRESS.csv and dropped, rather than fed downstream.

pasa_shared_min_avg_per_id.description: Relaxed PASA --pasa_min_avg_per_id used only in FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's shared-Trinity (cross-strain) branches, where alignment reflects real strain-to-strain divergence, not assembly error.

pasa_shared_min_pct_aligned.description: Relaxed PASA --pasa_min_pct_aligned used only in FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's shared-Trinity (cross-strain) branches.

pasa_shared_num_bp_splice.description: Relaxed PASA --NUM_BP_PERFECT_SPLICE_BOUNDARY used only in FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's shared-Trinity (cross-strain) branches.

pasa_composite_min_avg_per_id.description: PASA --pasa_min_avg_per_id for FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's 'composite' tier: hybrid-cross species trained against their real PARENT species' concatenated Trinity-GG assemblies. Stricter than pasa_shared_min_avg_per_id above (not looser) -- a parent's transcript should align to ITS OWN subgenome copy at ~99-100% identity, so a loose threshold here risks the wrong parent's transcript cross-mapping onto a subgenome it doesn't belong to. See nextflow/docs/HYBRID_SPECIES_RNASEQ_SKIP_PLAN.md. Provisional default, not yet empirically calibrated.

pasa_composite_min_pct_aligned.description: PASA --pasa_min_pct_aligned for FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's 'composite' tier. Provisional default, not yet empirically calibrated.

pasa_composite_fallback_min_avg_per_id.description: Relaxed PASA --pasa_min_avg_per_id for FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's 'composite_fallback' tier: hybrid-cross species with no parent-specific Trinity-GG data, trained against any genus-mate's instead. Genuinely wide-open cross-species divergence, unlike the parent-matched 'composite' tier above, so this one keeps loose thresholds. See nextflow/docs/HYBRID_SPECIES_RNASEQ_SKIP_PLAN.md. Provisional default, not yet empirically calibrated.

pasa_composite_fallback_min_pct_aligned.description: Relaxed PASA --pasa_min_pct_aligned for FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN's 'composite_fallback' tier. Provisional default, not yet empirically calibrated.

predict_min_asm_bp.description: Pre-flight: assembled bp below this counts as 'small' (0 disables the guard).

predict_frag_max_n50.description: Pre-flight: N50 below this counts as 'fragmented'.

predict_frag_max_contigs.description: Pre-flight: contig count above this counts as 'fragmented'.

share_abinitio_params.description: Reuse trained AUGUSTUS/SNAP/GeneMark-ES parameters from a species' ANI-qualified representative instead of retraining per strain. See todo/species_level_abinitio_reuse.md.

gene_prediction_shared_abinitio.description: Root of the species_reuse_clusters.py-backfilled shared ab-initio parameter stores (top-level, not nested under target).

force_independent_species.description: Comma-separated SPECIES values to always train independently, overriding reuse_eligible.

predict_scope.description: FUNANNOTATE_PREDICTION scope: 'all' predicts every strain (representatives first, no waiting); 'representative_only' predicts only representative strains.

busco_genome_dir.description: BUSCO genome-mode results dir, consulted by ANI_REPRESENTATIVE_SELECT for representative selection.

run_genemark.description: Run standalone GENEMARK_RUN before predict and feed it --genemark_gtf. false reproduces predict's own --auto-skip-genemark degradation (host GENEMARK_PATH unavailable/not wanted). See nextflow/docs/GENEMARK_RUN_DESIGN.md.

genemark_sif.description: Path to the Singularity image GENEMARK_RUN execs gmes_petap.pl/bam2hints/join_mult_hints.pl from. Default is a local conversion of docker://teambraker/braker3 (public, bundles GeneMark-ES/ET 4.72). GeneMark still requires a user-obtained license key (~/.gm_key) independent of which image runs it. A privately-built GeneMark-only alternative (https://github.com/hyphaltip/genemark-container) is also available in this lab's Singularity cache.

genemark_mode.description: GeneMark run mode (T-022, both wired). ET uses RNA-seq intron hints (needs a training_bam); GENEMARK_RUN falls back to ES automatically when no RNA-seq is available for a strain.

genemark_force_independent_strains.description: Comma-separated OUT (species_strain dir name) values to always run GeneMark independently (fresh --ES) for, ignoring an otherwise-available shared species .mod. Finer-grained than force_independent_species: lets AUGUSTUS/SNAP reuse stay on for a strain while forcing GeneMark specifically to retrain (e.g. validating reuse on a borderline-ANI strain).

train_min_trinity_transcripts.description: FUNANNOTATE_TRAIN pre-flight guard: minimum transcript count required in the shared Trinity-GG assembly before training proceeds; below this, training is skipped as likely assembled against the wrong reference strain. Set to 0 to disable the guard.

rnaseq_representative_override_csv.description: species_tag,out overrides for which strain RNASEQ_PREPARE builds the shared Trinity-GG assembly against, generated by scripts/pick_rnaseq_representative_override.py when the ANI+BUSCO representative pick's RNA-seq doesn't align well. Absent by default -- every species then keeps using the ANI+BUSCO pick unchanged.

hybrid_parentage_csv.description: hybrid_species_tag,parent_species rows for interspecific hybrid-cross species (e.g. "Saccharomyces cerevisiae x Saccharomyces eubayanus"), generated/relinted by scripts/bootstrap_hybrid_metadata.py. A hybrid species_tag present here is routed to composite parent-transcript RNA-seq evidence instead of the normal per-species representative pick; see nextflow/docs/HYBRID_SPECIES_RNASEQ_SKIP_PLAN.md.

rnaseq_skip_csv.description: out,reason rows for strains that should skip PASA/RNA-seq training outright and go straight to ab-initio-only prediction, regardless of ani_to_representative -- for cases where switching the RNA-seq representative still doesn't produce usable evidence (e.g. the shared Trinity-GG genuinely doesn't map to this strain's genome no matter which sibling strain's reads built it). Unlike suppress.txt, this keeps the strain in ANI/ab-initio reuse and every other stage. Absent by default -- every strain then keeps its normal ANI-based tier.

antismash_sif.description: antiSMASH Singularity image used by funannotate's ANTISMASH_RUN/SETUP_ANTISMASH_DB modules, pinned to the exact bioconda build backing the antismash_databases directory (distinct from the BFD pipeline's antismash_standalone_sif, which is a different, incompatible image+DB).

bfd_functional_options.title: BFD.nf functional-annotation options
bfd_functional_options.description: Input/output dirs and per-tool toggles for the functional annotation pipeline.

run_swissprot_annot.description: Build the SwissProt accession -> annotation table (BUILD_SWISSPROT_ANNOT).

swissprot_search.description: SwissProt search engine: 'diamond' (diamond blastp --sensitive container) or 'blastp' (NCBI blastp container).

blastp_sif.description: NCBI BLAST+ 2.16.0 Singularity image (blastp engine and RUN_MEROPS).

run_phobius.description: Run Phobius (RUN_PHOBIUS) for combined signal-peptide/TM prediction.

run_deeptmhmm.description: Run DeepTMHMM (RUN_DEEPTMHMM) for deep-learning TM-topology calling.

run_tf.description: Derive a transcription-factor inventory from RUN_PFAM's domtblout hits (MERGE_TF).

run_antismash.description: Run antiSMASH (RUN_ANTISMASH) for secondary-metabolite BGC prediction.

run_trnascan.description: Run tRNAscan-SE (RUN_TRNASCAN) with gene-overlap filtering, mirroring funannotate's own tRNA handling.

run_infernal.description: Run Infernal cmscan against Rfam (RUN_INFERNAL) for structured ncRNA calling.

run_cazy_cgc.description: Run full run_dbcan CGC/PUL clustering (RUN_CAZY_CGC) -- unvalidated, see module comment.

eggnog_data_dir.description: eggNOG-mapper data dir (reused from the funannotate profile's own eggnog_data_dir).

deeptmhmm_gpu.description: Route RUN_DEEPTMHMM to a GPU node.

tcdb_dbdir.description: SETUP_TCDB_DB's storeDir for tcdb.fasta + BLAST db.

antismash_standalone_sif.description: antiSMASH standalone-commercial Singularity image (BFD pipeline only; distinct from funannotate's antismash_sif, which is a different bioconda image paired with a different DB -- the two are not interchangeable).

dbcan_cgc_sif.description: run_dbcan (full, not dbcanlight) Singularity image for CGC/PUL clustering.

dbcan_dbdir.description: SETUP_DBCAN_DB's storeDir for the full run_dbcan reference set.

pfam_sif.description: HMMER 3.4 Singularity image for RUN_PFAM's hmmsearch.

telomere_patterns.description: List of telomere monomer patterns to search (IUPAC allowed).

telomere_min_repeats.description: Minimum tandem repeat count to report a tract.

telomere_flank_window.description: Inward flanking sequence length (bp) to report.

telomere_search_window.description: Terminal window (bp) in which to search for telomeres.

telomere_fuzzy.description: Use fuzzy (approximate) repeat matching instead of exact regex.

telomere_max_mismatch.description: Max mismatches per monomer in fuzzy mode.

telomere_max_indel.description: Max indels per monomer in fuzzy mode.

telomere_both_ends.description: Search every pattern at both 5' and 3' ends (default: canonical orientation only).

telomere_allow_internal.description: Report non-terminal tracts inside the search window.

telomere_terminal_tolerance.description: A tract is 'terminal' if within this many bp of the literal scaffold edge (assemblies often carry a few non-canonical bases before the repeat locks into register).

bfd_debug.description: Emit warnings when input files are missing (e.g. 'Skipping protein file'). Useful for debugging; set to false to suppress noisy skips during routine runs.

ani_options.title: ANI (average nucleotide identity) comparison options
ani_options.description: Parameters for compare_ANI.nf and query_ANI.nf workflows.

compare.description: Taxonomic rank to group genomes for comparison.

min_group_size.description: Minimum genomes to form a comparison group.

skani_compression.description: skani compression level (0 = use preset default).

ani_batch_size.description: Upper-triangle batch size (0 = single job per group).

skani_prefilter.description: Use mash pre-clustering for skani (same cascade as fastani_prefilter, independent toggle).

prefilter_ani.description: Mash ANI % floor for prefilter cascade.

query_top_n.description: Keep top N reference hits per query.

fallback.description: Group orphans by next rank above query_rank.

ani_reuse_threshold.description: ANI % threshold for strain reuse eligibility.
